== change
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Add a 1 GiB swap file (routine; undo with `oapctl host undo swap-file`)      │
│ because 985 MiB memory, no swap                                              │
│                                                                              │
│   │ set -eu                                                                  │
│   │ if [ -e /swapfile ]; then echo "oap: /swapfile already exists and OAP    │
│     didn't create it" >&2; exit 3; fi                                        │
│   │ fallocate -l 1G /swapfile 2>/dev/null || dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile    │
│     bs=1M count=1024 status=none                                             │
│   │ chmod 600 /swapfile                                                      │
│   │ mkswap /swapfile >/dev/null                                              │
│   │ swapon /swapfile                                                         │
│   │ grep -qxF '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0 # added by oap (swap-file)'        │
│     /etc/fstab || printf '%s\n' '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0 # added by oap   │
│     (swap-file)' >> /etc/fstab                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
